tier_rules.B1_below_GA: likely_broken: the chimera's best domain hit scores below the family's Pfam domain GA while both parents' domains score at or above GA (or the chimera has no hit at all).
tier_rules.B2_low_coverage: likely_broken: the chimera's hits in the domain together span < 50% of the HMM's match states while both parents pass GA.
tier_rules.B3_point_feature_lost: likely_broken: a UniProt Active site / Binding site / Site residue of either parent is absent from the chimera and no chimera residue occupies its aligned column (junction-deleted column, or a column where the other parent has a gap).
tier_rules.U1_parent_below_GA: uncertain: a parent's own domain scores below GA, so GA is not informative for this pair.
tier_rules.U2_bit_drop: uncertain: chimera domain bits are more than 10 below the weaker parent's.
tier_rules.U4_point_feature_altered: uncertain: a point key residue differs from both parents' aligned residues.
tier_rules.U5_indel_in_ss: uncertain: a junction indel residue is helix/strand in a parent model.
tier_rules.U6_indel_near_key: uncertain: the junction has an indel and lies within 5 residues of a key feature.
tier_rules.U7_junction_outside_hit: uncertain: the chimera's best hit does not span the junction (it may be one parent's fragment).
tier_rules.U8_domain_split: uncertain: HMMER splits the chimeric domain into more hits than either parent's domain.
tier_rules.U9_motif_lost_or_altered: uncertain: a motif-scale (<= 10 residues) UniProt DNA-binding / Motif / Region feature has a residue that is lost or altered (not merely swapped for the other parent's aligned residue). Longer regions are reported, not tiered: past the crossover they are routinely replaced by the other parent's equivalent region, and their domain-scale integrity is what the HMM rules measure.
tier_rules.N1_missing: not_assessed: an input needed to call likely_intact is missing, rejected or incomplete (listed in tier_missing_inputs).
tier_rules.I1_all_pass: likely_intact: none of the above fired and every input was assessed (passes GA, coverage >= 80%, bit drop <= 10, no key point site or motif-scale feature lost/altered, no key residue unresolved, any indel outside parent helix/strand and away from key residues, both parent structures validated).

tier_required_inputs_for_likely_intact: no unresolved in-domain key residue position (key_unresolved_positions == 0)
indel secondary structure when the junction has an indel
record_identity: record_id: family, class, parent transcripts, parent domain spans, junction residues, hybrid residue, chimeric domain span and flanked sequence; sequence_id: family, parent transcripts and flanked sequence
read_support_rule: samples counted once per biological sample (both TARGET tables share one namespace); a sample's reads = max over its rows, never summed; total = sum over samples of per-sample max
